# 00000003904

**English.** Definition: The d-Veronese subring is the subring generated by all monomials of degree d. Conjecture: The d-Veronese is strongly F-regular for every d, and its F-signature satisfies s = (1/d^n)(1 + c(n)/d + O(1/d^2)), where c(n) is an explicit rational function of n. (Veronese F-signature asymptotics)

**中文。** 定义：d-Veronese 子环指由全体 d 次单项式生成的子环。猜想：d-Veronese 对一切 d 强 F-正则,且其 F-signature 满足 s = 1/d^n 乘 (1 + c(n)/d + O(1/d²)),其中 c(n) 为与 n 有关的显式有理函数。（Veronese F-signature 渐近）
